notice: Illustrative scenarios only. Headlines and contracts are fictional; no live data, market identities, or trading predictions are represented. This is a proposed output format, not an available API.

source.label: Illustrative social post
source.text: White House proposes higher tariffs on imported vehicles.

related_markets.question: Will the US announce new auto tariffs this quarter?
related_markets.context: The proposal concerns an announcement. Final contract rules would need to establish what qualifies.

related_markets.question: Will higher auto tariffs take effect this quarter?
related_markets.context: A proposal is related news, but does not establish that tariffs have taken effect.

source.label: Illustrative news headline
source.text: US annual inflation falls below 3% in the latest release.

related_markets.question: Will annual CPI be below 3% in this release?
related_markets.context: The headline addresses the threshold. The release period, series, and contract rules still need verification.

related_markets.context: Inflation provides policy context. It does not establish a future rate decision.

records.caveat: An inflation print is not a rate decision.
